g.text: OAuth 2.0 Authorization Code Grant with Bearer Token Use
Register client_id, redirect_uri, client secret (out of band)
302 to /authorize with response_type=code, client_id, scope, state, code_challenge (redirect)
GET /authorize then login and consent screen
302 to redirect_uri with code and state (redirect)
POST /token with grant_type=authorization_code, code, code_verifier, client authentication
Validate token by JWT verification or introspection
Identity is per authorization server. A client_id means nothing anywhere else.
Consent is a standing grant of scopes. It carries no statement of why or for which task.
⚠️ SECURITY: Bearer means possession is authority. Anyone holding the token can use it unless DPoP or mTLS binding is added.
